Iranians Rally in Large-Scale Defiance

Hundreds of thousands of Iranians participated in a rally described as the largest show of defiance since the start of the war. The event saw a massive turnout, with participants expressing their opposition. The scale of the gathering was noted as significant in the context of ongoing tensions.
